subject: Re: Evaluation exchange — MAP, sample prompt pack, and bounded-use schedule
messages:
From: Dana McCall <dana@brightcart.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: eval@brightcart.com
Date: Tue, 25 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exchange for evaluation — MAP and limited-use prompt pack

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and determinism numbers look promising for our checkout-assist pilot. We'd like to move to a brief mutual action plan so we can exchange a small evaluation dataset and a prompt pack for a 30-day trial in our sandbox.

High level asks from BrightCart:
- A MAP with milestone dates for delivery, acceptance, and takedown.
- A bounded-use license for the prompt pack (no redistribution, internal-only for evaluation).
- A canary/mini dataset (<= 1k examples) we can run in our staging environment.
- Security checklist and data handling notes (SOC2 scope, retention).

Can you share a proposed MAP and the prompt pack sample? Happy to sign a one-way NDA if needed.

Goal: pilot starts week of Dec 8, finish acceptance by Jan 8.

Best,
Dana
--
Dana McCall
Head of Data Science, BrightCart
From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: Dana McCall <dana@brightcart.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 26 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exchange for evaluation — MAP and limited-use prompt pack

Dana — great to hear, and thanks for the clear timeline. Attaching a proposed MAP (BrightCart_MAP_v1.pdf) and a small example prompt pack (brightcart_promptpack_sample.zip). Quick summary below and suggested milestones: 

Summary (what we propose)
- We will provision a sandbox lane with a canary dataset (canary-mini-sample.jsonl, ~800 records).
- Usage constraints: evaluation-only, no external redistribution, tokens and embeddings may be logged for quality/rate limiting but raw examples will not be retained beyond 30 days unless agreed.
- Delivery dates: MAP signature by Nov 30, sandbox provisioning Dec 4, canary run and initial eval Dec 8–12, final acceptance by Jan 8.

Attachments in this email (stubs):
- BrightCart_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft: milestones, responsibilities, acceptance criteria)
- brightcart_promptpack_sample.zip (10 example prompts, README with label schema)
- canary-mini-sample.jsonl (sample data preview, redacted PII)

Notes and asks for you:
1) Confirm the acceptance criteria in the MAP (we included a small prompt set for automatic pass/fail thresholds + human spot-check).
2) Legal: if you prefer different retention windows or need a JMLA addendum, point us to your counsel.

Looping in Karthik and Marissa for provisioning and instrumenting the acceptance checklist.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick call Thu if you want to walk the plan.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 27 Nov 2025 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Re: Exchange for evaluation — MAP and limited-use prompt pack

Adding a quick internal note / redline request:

Lauren — thanks for the draft. A couple of internal asks before we send a redline back: 
- Retention: suggest 14-day default for raw canary artifacts unless BrightCart signs the extended 30-day clause.
- Logging: we should be explicit that token-level logs are retained only for billing/ops for 7 days; any debug dumps require explicit permission.
- Sandbox quota: confirm they only need single GPU throughput and not an HA lane. If they expect multi-concurrent UI loads we'll scope Dedicated.

Marissa / Ben — please prepare a short provisioning plan showing: sandbox credentials flow, IAM roles, and how we will enforce the bounded-use label on the prompt pack (ACLs + watermarking note).

I'll prepare a redline (redline_map_karthik_v1.pdf) and share by EOD.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Dana McCall <dana@brightcart.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: eval@brightcart.com
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2025 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exchange for evaluation — MAP and limited-use prompt pack

Thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifications from BrightCart: 
- We can accept the 14-day retention for raw canary artifacts; 30 days preferred but 14 is fine for the initial run.
- Logging: 7-day token/log retention OK. We only need single-concurrency testing for the pilot.
- We will need a canary that includes 50 synthetic edge cases; can you confirm your canary-mini-sample includes a synthetic edge split?

We can review your redline, and I can get my procurement counsel to look at the MAP doc early next week. Also — we'd prefer DocuSign for the MAP when redlines are accepted.

Would you be able to provision the sandbox lane on Dec 4 as proposed? That date is key to our internal sprint planning.

Appreciate the quick turn.

— Dana
Dana McCall
Head of Data Science, BrightCart
